description: One chat message: a right-aligned bubble for the user, a left block for the assistant with a working toolbar (read aloud, copy, thumbs up/down) + optional quick-reply chips. Shared by every chat surface.

props.name: text
props.description: Plain text of the message — used by copy + read-aloud on assistant rows.

props.name: choices
props.description: Quick-reply chips under an assistant message.

props.name: hideActions
props.description: Hide the built-in action toolbar (copy / read / feedback).

props.name: onDislike
props.description: Fired when the user picks thumbs-down (e.g. to open a feedback dialog).

example:
<Grid columns={12}>
  <GridItem span={6}>
    <Stack gap={4}>
      <ChatMessage role="user" text={QUESTION}>{QUESTION}</ChatMessage>
      <ChatMessage role="assistant" text={ANSWER} onDislike={() => undefined}>
        {ANSWER}
      </ChatMessage>
    </Stack>
  </GridItem>
</Grid>
